name: drupal/custom_formatters
description: The Custom Formatters module allows users to easily create custom Field Formatters without the need to write a custom module

suggest.drupal/codemirror_editor: Provides syntax-highlighted code editing via CodeMirror for the PHP, HTML+Token, and Twig formatter engines.
suggest.drupal/devel: Provides debug output options for the preview feature and Devel Generate integration for generating sample preview content.
suggest.drupal/token: Provides token replacement support for the HTML Token formatter type.
